claim: Patchline ships a multi-implementation conformance suite proving independent certificate checkers agree. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the conformance suite claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-impl-conformance-gate`.
